native_interface_static_audit.input: Concatenated two native Bx3xHxW float32 images in [0,1]; use native timestamps for timestep
native_interface_static_audit.official_cli_color_order: OpenCV imread BGR; RGB source arrays may be reversibly channel-reordered to reproduce this interface
native_interface_static_audit.padding: Pad right/bottom to multiple of 32 then crop prediction back to original H,W; no input resize
native_interface_static_audit.output: IFNet_m.forward returns flow_list, mask, merged, flow_teacher, merged_teacher, loss_distill; use merged[2] as auxiliary predicted center
native_interface_static_audit.teacher_branch: Not activated for six-channel input (no center/GT image supplied)
native_interface_static_audit.native_1080p_and_4k: No fixed H/W in static architecture; actual memory, runtime and successful forward not yet measured
do_not_use: Practical-RIFE inference_img.py has an unconditional 448x256 resize for ordinary images
ECCV2022-RIFE inference_video.py has SSIM-dependent frame handling and UHD scale override; avoid video CLI
Original Model.load_model uses torch.load without explicit weights_only or map_location; use an audited restricted-load wrapper
Do not replace, insert, drop, smooth, re-encode or retime any original frame
Do not supply observed center pixels to the inference input or teacher branch
